run_modular_addition: run the modular_addition function to compute (x + y) % mod for two integers
generate_dataset_modular_addition: generate a dataset of modular addition pairs using generate_dataset2 with two moduli M1 and M2
test_modular_addition_model: test a trained ModularAdditionNN model on test data and return per-output accuracy scores
build_modular_addition_nn: build a ModularAdditionNN neural network with embedding, hidden layers, and multiple output heads
train_modular_addition_model: train a ModularAdditionNN model on a modular addition dataset using Adam optimizer and cross entropy loss
